transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I understand we're here to discuss the prior-learning credit petition from the student who's seeking college credit based on their work experience in biological laboratory operations. Before I make my binding decision, I'd like to make sure we follow our standard process. I'll need to hear from the faculty assessor regarding their report, and I'll also need the registrar's records review. Could we proceed with those updates?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Dr. Morgan. Yes, I'm ready to present my faculty assessment report. I completed the assessment this week, evaluating the student's portfolio and conducting an observed practical. I can confirm that the portfolio and observed practical together demonstrate the competencies for exactly 6 credits of college credit in biological laboratory operations. However, I want to be clear that this credit recommendation is valid only if the observed practical is included alongside the portfolio in our review — the portfolio alone would not be sufficient to support the credit recommendation. I'd be happy to answer any questions before we hear from the registrar.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Dr. Morgan, as part of my records review, I must note that I confirmed in the state articulation record that these competencies must be posted as course equivalency BIO-115 with a CR transcript notation, rather than as general biology elective credit or a letter grade. This is a binding requirement from the state articulation record that will govern how any approved credit is recorded on the student's transcript.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Approved credit will be posted as course equivalency BIO-115 with a CR transcript notation, per the binding state articulation record requirement.
The faculty assessment report, including both the portfolio and observed practical, will be filed as the basis for the 6-credit recommendation.
